value.rationale: The two independent superexponential escape clocks and the sharp ratio thresholds one and two give a nontrivial projective compactification of infinity for a natural Hénon family. The two critical bisectors are quantitatively delicate (requiring additive o(1) log errors), and open realizability of all strict phases plus nonempty transition sets matters for dynamical descriptions beyond local attractor bifurcation diagrams. Scope is consciously local to a motivated large-amplitude chamber, not arbitrary slices or tiny numerical improvements.
